title_options: Kevin James Tried One Cheat Day A Week. It Wrecked His Diet.
You Can't Outwork A Bad Diet. Kevin James Was Right.
Why One Cheat Day Can Outweigh Six Days Of Dieting
Kevin James' Trainer Was Right About Cheat Days
No Cheat Days. Make It A Cheat Meal Instead.
youtube_description:
Kevin James says you can't outwork a bad diet, and he admits his trainer was right. And he was right. Kevin James and his trainer are absolutely right about this. One single cheat day can outweigh six days of hard dieting. If you have a cheat day, even if you're dieting hard all the other six days, then you're most likely not going to lose any weight.

So I would say just make it one cheat meal and not a cheat day. And whether you're doing a cheat meal or a cheat day, track your calories. No cheat days. Make it a cheat meal only, and still track when you cheat.
